chunks: Surely the angels will come down to those who say, 'Our Lord is God' and then remain steadfast, saying: 'You should have neither fear nor regret, but rejoice in the happy news of Paradise that has been promised you.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who remain steadfast in faith according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Istiqamah' (steadfastness) is interpreted not merely as initial belief but as enduring consistency in faith and practice, particularly through adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt. The descent of angels signifies divine comfort during the transition of the soul, reinforcing the promise of eternal bliss for those who maintain this spiritual equilibrium.
